title: An integer overflow in the MessagePack\BufferUnpacker component of rybakit/msgpack v0.11.0 allows attackers to cause a…
description: An integer overflow vulnerability exists in the MessagePack\BufferUnpacker component of rybakit/msgpack version 0.11.0. This flaw allows attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by providing crafted input to the vulnerable component.
